newsitem.title: CANADA: CANADA'S PRAIRIES TO SEE CLOUD WEST, SUN EAST.
newsitem.headline: CANADA'S PRAIRIES TO SEE CLOUD WEST, SUN EAST.

text.p: Canada's Prairies on Wednesday were forecast to see cloud west, sun east, Environment Canada said.
Alberta should see cloudy skies and a chance of showers in the north with highs of 24 to 30 Celsius.
Saskatchewan should see clouds in the west, sun in the east and highs of 22 to 27 Celsius.
Manitoba should see sunny skies with highs of 15 to 25 Celsius.
